name: person-hover-card
title: Person Hover Card
description: Stacked avatars with a hover card per person — a compact card with a 32px avatar, with the name and muted email beside it — and the rest behind "+N".

meta.whenToUse: Show the people on a record (participants, watchers, a team) as stacked avatars, each previewing the person on hover, focus or tap.
meta.whenNotToUse: A picker of people (SearchableSelect) or a full member list (DataList).
